name: Crisphive
description:
Crisphive is developer-first scheduling infrastructure for AI agents, applications, and field operations platforms.

Connect Claude to Crisphive through MCP to give your agent access to real scheduling intelligence — without building a scheduling engine from scratch.

Crisphive helps AI agents determine:
- When can the job happen? Match customer requests against real business availability and operational constraints.
- Who should do it? Assign the right person or team based on availability, location, skills, certifications, and job requirements.
- How should the day be scheduled? Route field teams while accounting for travel, job duration, availability, and operational dependencies.
- What happens when the day changes? Automatically cascade schedule changes when jobs run long, emergencies arrive, or appointments move.

TRY THESE FIRST
- "Find 3 hours this week for a bike ride with my wife without risking any jobs."
- "Emergency plumbing job now at 99 Bank St for David Okafor (613-555-0198) — show me what gets rescheduled."
- "Schedule a 2-hour HVAC job at 145 Laurier Ave W tomorrow for Marie Tremblay, 613-555-0142."

WHAT DEVELOPERS CAN BUILD
Use the Crisphive MCP to add scheduling intelligence to AI voice agents, customer booking agents, dispatch copilots, field operations agents, CRM assistants, vertical SaaS products, and multi-agent systems.

SOLVE REAL FIELD-OPERATIONS PROBLEMS
- Double-booking and phantom availability — only offer appointment times that can actually be fulfilled.
- Wrong-person dispatch — match work to technicians based on skills, certifications, geography, and availability.

BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS
Crisphive is designed as infrastructure rather than a replacement for the systems your customers already use. Your application owns the workflow. Crisphive provides the scheduling intelligence underneath it.

Build field-operations agents that can do more than recommend what should happen. Give them the infrastructure to schedule it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Crisphive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Crisphive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.crisphive.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Crisphive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crisphive lists 43 MCP tools, including commitEmergencyReschedule, commitJobRequestMove, confirmJobRequest, createCustomer, createJobRequest, createTechnician, deleteCustomer, deleteTechnician, getCustomer, getJobRequest, getJobRequestTimeline, and getJobType.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Crisphive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Crisphive in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Crisphive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Crisphive is developed by Crisphive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
